rationale: The digest shows emailservice latency-90 and latency-50 spiked by 4498.7% and 1334.4% respectively (z-scores >266), while CPU and workload metrics remained stable. The retrieved runbook explicitly links this latency degradation to conntrack limits causing dropped connections, confirming a socket exhaustion fault.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the node conntrack limit or tune connection pooling and retry policies for emailservice to prevent connection exhaustion and request drops.
